authority.head_semantics: V3.1 protocol, tooling, label-free audit, and prepare-only packet freeze commit before governance-document synchronization

claim_ceiling: Report deterministic RQ1 distributions only for the frozen 8066-row CVE-aligned NVD-GHSA cohort.
Treat all existing AI or Codex labels as non-human candidate or retrospective evidence.
Treat label-free policy and safety-identifiability audits as design evidence only, never correctness, noninferiority, utility, or population miss-rate evidence.
Require two independent V3.1 action-first and reason-second human passes before construct or policy-performance claims.
Treat field-aware simple as the main comparator, current type-first as the efficiency arm, and abstention-aware type-first as the safety arm.
Require both reviewers to clear the frozen reliability, efficiency, and safety gates for positive efficiency-safety framing; otherwise use the boundary or decision-ambiguity route.
Do not call routing counts workload, saved time, or safety without human-backed evidence and explicit abstention accounting.
Do not claim temporal generalization without a newly eligible bilateral post-freeze cohort.
open_blockers: V3.1 packets and analysis tooling are mechanically frozen, but distribution remains blocked and real-human labels remain zero.
The V3.1 guideline lacks author approval; reviewer identity, independence, role, compensation, conflicts, and ethics or recruitment disposition are unrecorded.
Calibration-1 has not run; action and reason stage locks contain no real returns.
The S2 title direction and contribution wording still require author lock after preserving both positive and boundary result routes.
Current JSS submission requirements and author metadata are not frozen.
